title: Codebase Architecture & Structure
scope: Map the overall layout, entry points, build system, and module organization of the kimi-cli repository.

title: CLI Framework & Command Layer
scope: Identify the CLI framework used and map the full command tree (commands, subcommands, flags).

title: Core Feature Set & KIMI API Integration
scope: Understand the core KIMI model integration, provider calls, and chat/completion logic.

title: Config & State Management
scope: Document how config files, env vars, history, and chat sessions are persisted.

title: Output Rendering & UI Layer
scope: Catalog the UX niceties: terminal formatting, colors, progress indicators, interactive prompts, markdown/code rendering.

title: Testing Strategy & Quality Gates
scope: Survey the test suite, coverage approach, quality gates, and CI expectations.

title: Build & Release Pipeline
scope: Map how the project builds, packages, versions, and releases (CI/CD, changelog, publishing).

title: Extensibility & Plugin Model
scope: Identify plugin/extension systems, custom commands, or scripting hooks.

title: Error Handling, Logging & Observability
scope: Analyze error classes, retry semantics, logging conventions, and observability (`vis/`).

title: Docs, Examples & User Onboarding
scope: Evaluate documentation quality, example scripts, scripts/, and user guidance.
